assessment_questions.questionText: In a standard Indian single-phase 230V residential circuit, which wire color code is designated for Protective Earth (PE) under IS 732?
assessment_questions.scenarioContext: You are wiring a 16A geyser socket in a newly plastered bathroom in Latur.
options: Green or Green-with-Yellow stripe
Black
Red
Blue
assessment_questions.explanation: Green / Green-Yellow is strictly designated for Protective Earth to prevent shock on metallic appliance enclosures.

assessment_questions.questionText: A homeowner reports that a 32A RCCB trips immediately whenever the kitchen microwave is switched on, though individual MCBs do not trip. What is the primary fault to inspect?
assessment_questions.scenarioContext: Troubleshooting a live distribution board with a clamp/insulation tester.
options: Earth leakage or Neutral-to-Earth short in the appliance/socket circuit
Supply voltage from transformer is 235V
Ceiling fan capacitor degradation in bedroom
Undersized main energy meter display
assessment_questions.explanation: RCCBs detect current imbalance between Phase and Neutral caused by Earth leakage or Neutral-Earth contact.

assessment_questions.questionText: Before connecting an inverter output wire to selected lighting/fan points inside a room switchboard, what critical isolation step is mandatory?
options: Disconnect the grid phase loop feeding those backup switches so grid & inverter phases never collide
Connect inverter output directly across main 2-pole isolator input
Remove the earthing wire from the switchboard
Bypass all miniature circuit breakers
assessment_questions.explanation: Isolating backup load switches from the raw grid phase loop prevents catastrophic back-feeding.

assessment_questions.questionText: Why must yellow CPVC solvent cement be used on hot-water geyser lines instead of standard blue UPVC solvent?
assessment_questions.scenarioContext: Installing concealed hot/cold mixer lines inside bathroom brickwork.
options: CPVC resin handles up to 82–93°C hot water chemically; UPVC solvent softens and leaks under heat
Yellow solvent dries slower for aesthetic reasons only
UPVC pipes have higher thermal rating than CPVC
Solvent color only indicates pipe diameter
assessment_questions.explanation: CPVC solvent fuses chlorinated PVC molecules rated for high-temperature hot water lines.

assessment_questions.questionText: Before wall tiles are laid over concealed bathroom piping, what hydro-test check confirms leak-free joints?
assessment_questions.scenarioContext: Handover check with civil tile mason waiting.
options: Pressurize line to 1.5x working pressure (~6–10 bar) with hand test pump and monitor gauge drop for at least 30–60 minutes
Pour a bucket of water over the wall plaster
Tap pipes with a steel hammer
Tile immediately while solvent is still wet
assessment_questions.explanation: Hydrostatic pressure testing before tiling catches pin-hole joint leaks prior to costly wall finishing.

assessment_questions.questionText: Which plywood grade is strictly recommended for modular kitchen sink-unit carcasses exposed to moisture?
assessment_questions.scenarioContext: Advising a customer on durable kitchen cabinetry.
options: IS:710 Certified Boiling Water Proof (BWP / Marine) Plywood or HDHMR
Interior MR Commercial Particle Board without edge banding
Unseasoned soft pine packing crate wood
3mm MDF backing sheet
assessment_questions.explanation: IS:710 BWP Marine plywood resists delamination in high-humidity under-sink zones.

assessment_questions.questionText: When mounting heavy overhead kitchen wall cabinets on a brick wall, what ensures level alignment and load safety?
options: Spirit/laser level datum line + heavy-duty wall-hanging brackets anchored into solid masonry
Fixing with 1-inch headless finish nails into wall putty
Relying only on silicone sealant along backsplash tiles
Aligning visually with floor skirting without level check
assessment_questions.explanation: Laser/spirit datum lines plus deep masonry anchors prevent cabinet sag or pull-out failure.

assessment_questions.questionText: In Maharashtra (Northern Hemisphere), which direction and approximate tilt angle maximize annual rooftop solar PV generation?
assessment_questions.scenarioContext: Laying out a 5kW residential solar structure in Pune/Latur (~18.5°N latitude).
options: True South facing at ~18°–20° tilt angle without shadow obstruction
True North facing at 45° tilt angle
Flat 0° under overhead water tank shadow
West facing vertical wall mounting
assessment_questions.explanation: True South orientation at tilt approximately equal to local latitude (~18°–20°) maximizes annual irradiance.

assessment_questions.questionText: Why must MC4 connectors never be unplugged while a solar PV string is under load current in bright sunlight?
assessment_questions.scenarioContext: Routine maintenance on a 600V DC rooftop string.
options: High-voltage DC current draws a sustained plasma arc that can cause severe burns or fire; isolate AC/DC breakers first
It resets the customer Wi-Fi router
Solar panels generate AC 50Hz directly at panel terminals
MC4 connectors are single-use disposable clips
assessment_questions.explanation: DC has no zero-crossing point, so breaking load current creates dangerous sustained DC arcing.

assessment_questions.scenarioContext: Boutique Festive Silk & Cotton Lining Order
assessment_questions.questionText: When cutting a lined cotton-silk blouse for humid weather, what pre-stitching step prevents post-wash puckering?
options: Pre-shrinking cotton lining in water and pressing flat before marking
Stretching fabric diagonally on bias
Using maximum stitch tension
Skipping seam allowance
assessment_questions.explanation: Cotton lining shrinks more than silk outer fabric; pre-shrinking prevents seam distortion.

assessment_questions.questionText: What is the standard side-seam margin left in custom Indian boutique garments to allow client fit adjustments?
options: 0.25 inch
1.25 to 1.5 inches with three-line alteration margin
4 inches
No margin needed
assessment_questions.explanation: 1.25–1.5 inch side allowances provide clean alteration flexibility.

assessment_questions.questionText: Before checking capillary blood glucose with a glucometer at a patient’s home, what must you confirm after alcohol-swabbing the fingertip?
options: Prick while alcohol is still wet
Allow the fingertip to air-dry completely and never reuse lancets
Squeeze aggressively from palm
Use yesterday’s test strip
assessment_questions.explanation: Wet alcohol dilutes the sample and causes stinging; single-use sterile lancets prevent bloodborne infection.

assessment_questions.questionText: For a bedridden elderly patient, how often should gentle repositioning be performed to prevent pressure ulcers (bedsores)?
options: Once every 12 hours
Every 2 hours with pillow support at bony prominences
Only once a day
Never reposition
assessment_questions.explanation: Two-hourly turning schedules relieve capillary pressure on sacrum and heels.

assessment_questions.questionText: What is the maximum recommended horizontal run length for a standard Cat6 PoE Ethernet cable to an IP camera without a PoE extender?
options: 25 meters
90–100 meters
350 meters
500 meters
assessment_questions.explanation: IEEE 802.3 Ethernet/PoE specifies a 100-meter maximum channel length before signal/voltage drop.

assessment_questions.questionText: Which security practice is mandatory before handing over an NVR remote-viewing app to a shop or household client?
options: Leave factory password admin/12345
Change default admin credentials, enable strong password & disable unused open ports
Share RTSP link publicly
Disable recording
assessment_questions.explanation: Replacing factory credentials prevents unauthorized external camera access.

assessment_questions.questionText: Before disconnecting a 48V–72V traction battery pack or motor controller on an electric scooter, what is the first step?
options: Spray water on terminals
Turn ignition OFF, trip main MCB/isolation plug, wait for capacitor discharge & wear insulated gloves
Cut orange cable
Short terminals with wrench
assessment_questions.explanation: Isolating main breaker and allowing controller bus capacitors to discharge prevents DC arc flash.

assessment_questions.scenarioContext: Intermittent Power Cut Under Gradient Load
assessment_questions.questionText: If an EV scooter cuts power under climb load while showing 60% SOC, what commonly triggers the BMS cutoff?
options: Low tire shine
Weak/unbalanced cell group dropping below under-voltage threshold under load
Headlight bulb wattage
Mirror angle
assessment_questions.explanation: Cell imbalance causes a single weak series group to hit LVC under high current draw.

modules.title: Foundations, Tools & Safety Compliance for Weld Joint Inspection
modules.objective: Understand IS 816 Structural Welding & AWS Hot-Work Safety requirements, select and inspect the right tools/materials, and establish a safe workspace before performing Weld Joint Inspection.
topics: Core principles of Weld Joint Inspection within Welding & Fabrication (IS 816 Structural Welding & AWS Hot-Work Safety).
